VBO:0200317.summary: Deeply attached to familiar people, Lulu offers a firsthand glimpse of the Cavatzu, a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel–Shih Tzu cross. Her foster describes snuggling, sharing the bed and enjoying ball play, alongside quiet daytime naps. Meeting strangers is much harder: she warms up slowly, may growl when introductions move too fast, and was signed up for training to build confidence.
